Issue #542: AoT captures too many keys
Repository: python-poetry/tomlkit

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import tomlkit


doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
aot = tomlkit.aot()
t = tomlkit.table()
t["x"] = 9
aot.append(t)
doc["a"] = aot
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
```

```

import tomlkit


def test_aot_captures_too_many_keys():
    doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
    aot = tomlkit.aot()
    t = tomlkit.table()
    t["x"] = 9
    aot.append(t)
    doc["a"] = aot
    expected_dump = "[[a]]\nx = 9\n\nc.d = 2\n"
    assert tomlkit.dumps(doc) == expected_dump

```
